legend.//: full stop, about 0.8 s, let it land
legend.[lens]: lean in slightly, eyes on the lens
legend.[point]: point up at the graphic (Format A) or at the screen side (Format B)
legend.broll: B-roll to film after the take (3 to 5 s each, no talking)

defaults.pace: aim for 190 to 210 words a minute inside a sentence (Kallaway runs 210 to 240); keep a short beat between lines, never a long one
defaults.energy: 7 out of 10: awake and warm, not a hype voice
defaults.framing: chest up, a hand's width of space above your head, eyes on the lens
defaults.retake: If you fluff a line, pause, then say the whole line again. The edit keeps the last take.
defaults.broll: After the talking take, film the B-roll list on the same phone: 3 to 5 s each, steady, no talking, good light. Film your hands and screens more than your face. The edit cuts to one every few lines (research/creators/style-guide-2026-10-14.md).
defaults.angle: Film the hook and the CTA a second time from a different angle (wide, standing, or side) so the edit can cut between angles like @justyn.ai.

sheets.series: Extra format test (outside the 52 weeks): reaction + recreate
sheets.format: Part 1 = our loud v12 style; snap; Part 2 = her calm DNA (desk talk + overhead handwriting + soft piano). The contrast is the point
sheets.length: 45 to 55 s (her clips 6 s at most)
sheets.post: Any free slot after Week 2 is up; not instead of the series
sheets.cta: Comment CALM (resource: the calm-edit prompt, to build before posting) + question: slop or smart?
sheets.model: @mariah_mpls Derd9IvoWaj (19,265 likes, 563 comments, 23 Oct). We react with respect and recreate her FORMAT, never her words, set or series title. Credit her on screen and tag her

part_1_loud_look: Your usual spot and light, phone on the tripod, back camera, 4K 30 fps
Hook: 3 takes, from mildly hurt to really disappointed
The finger snap: 3 takes, hand close to the lens, then freeze for a second
part_2_her_dna: Daytime, next to a window, a tidy desk: notebook, a mug, a plant or books behind you
A plain sweater in one colour, a different top from part 1 so the switch is obvious
Camera still, at desk height, you centred with space around you (a mid shot)
Lines 7, 9, 10, 11 and 12 at the desk, calm and slower than usual, twice each
Overhead shot: phone above the desk looking straight down (a tripod arm, or the phone on a shelf or a stack of books)

Write each page slowly with a thick black pen, big letters, one page each: "weak story + effects = slop" / "1. story first  2. AI does the boring part" / "edited with AI ✓" / "same tool. different taste." / "comment CALM"
Keep your hands in shot; record 5 seconds of the room with no talking
write_down_first: The 5 notebook pages above, practised once on scrap paper so the letters are big and neat

sheets.edit_notes: Part 1 follows the v12 standard (punch-ins, 3D cards, a sound on every event). Part 2 copies her DNA: two alternating shots (desk / overhead hands), cuts every 3 to 4 s, no sound effects except the pen and the room, small white lowercase captions low in the frame, a serif title with one script word. Music: add "Twins" by Elia Lo Monaco from Instagram's own music picker when posting, under part 2 only; never bake a song into the file. Her clips: 6 s in total at most, credited on screen, for commentary only (German quotation right, § 51 UrhG: name the source, quote only what the comment needs). If her reel allows Remix, Instagram's Remix is the cleanest route.
broll: Your Week 1 reel frames for the 3D cards (already in the project)
Optional: a close-up of the pen cap clicking off before the first page
